decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software module that fits the firm's data-driven direction and is relatively cheap to maintain as an option, it would usually be retained unless clear negative market evidence appears.

Despite its lower standalone prominence, it remains a near-core process data software offer whose carrying costs are modest, so management would still keep it while using project demand to judge its longer-run value.

After several years the value of this narrower mechanical niche should be much clearer, and if it still lacks strong traction the firm would rationalize it in favor of stronger digital and systems-oriented options.

This flow measurement automation and system software is highly consistent with the firm's connected and predictive infrastructure strategy, and its option value remains attractive relative to the likely low cost of keeping it on offer.
